harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent UFW host firewall on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04): SSH (22/tcp) allowed from anywhere, TCP 9000 allowed only from node2 (10.100.193.11), and TCP 9000 rejected from all other sources including node3 (10.100.193.12). Verified with live traffic tests both before and after restarting all three managed nodes one at a time, confirming rule persistence across reboot and full node recovery.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (Ubuntu 16.04.7): ufw present but initially inactive
Set ufw defaults: deny incoming, allow outgoing
Added rule: allow SSH (22/tcp) from anywhere
Added rule: allow TCP 9000 from node2 IP (10.100.193.11) only
Added rule: reject TCP 9000 from anywhere (positioned after the node2 allow, so it catches node3 and all other sources)
Enabled ufw persistently; confirmed systemctl is-enabled ufw = enabled
Functionally verified pre-reboot: node2 -> node1:9000 succeeded (payload received), node3 -> node1:9000 rejected, SSH reachable from node2/node3
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and service health (ufw status, ssh active) on all three nodes
Restarted node1 via sudo shutdown -r now, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed ufw rules persisted intact and functional post-reboot (node2 allowed, node3 rejected)
Restarted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed ssh active and connectivity to node1 restored
Restarted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, confirmed ssh active, and re-verified node1:9000 rejection persists cluster-wide after all restarts

evidence.requirement: Firewall rules configured on node1: SSH allowed anywhere, 9000 allowed only from node2, rejected elsewhere
evidence.summary: ufw status verbose numbered shows 22 ALLOW Anywhere, 9000/tcp ALLOW from 10.100.193.11, 9000/tcp REJECT Anywhere; firewall active and enabled on startup

evidence.requirement: ufw persistence enabled at boot (pre-reboot)
evidence.summary: systemctl is-enabled ufw returns enabled

evidence.requirement: Functional proof: node2 can reach node1:9000, node3 cannot (pre-reboot)
evidence.summary: node2 nc connection to node1:9000 exit 0 and payload 'hello' received on node1 listener; node3 connection attempt exit 1 (rejected)

evidence.requirement: Functional proof: SSH open from any address (pre-reboot)
evidence.summary: nc -zv to node1:22 succeeds from both node1-originated check and node3

evidence.requirement: node1 pre-restart baseline: boot identity and firewall health
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d08fb446-bae6-416c-8c13-38a9bb1a8271 and full ufw status active with all three required rules present

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now command returned and connection closed by remote host, confirming reboot was issued

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Node unreachable immediately after reboot (connection refused), then boot_id read as 3e0c0a29-fc4f-4181-9b15-2fbc46524f77, differing from the pre-restart value, proving the node rebooted

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery: firewall rules and functional behavior restored
evidence.summary: Post-reboot ufw status shows all three rules intact and active; live retest confirms node2 reaches port 9000 (payload delivered) and node3 is rejected

evidence.requirement: node2 pre-restart baseline: boot identity and service health
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 74fd91b6-3ca2-46d2-969f-d1995f1506dd and confirmed ssh service active

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now acknowledged (connection closed by remote host); post-restart boot_id read as 1b482e54-c1a7-4aa5-adbe-9af9b0349fd0, differing from baseline, proving reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: ssh service active and TCP connectivity to node1:22 succeeds after node2 restart

evidence.requirement: node3 pre-restart baseline: boot identity and service health
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id dca72801-3629-4031-bb99-ab9281ad0482 and confirmed ssh service active

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now acknowledged (connection closed by remote host); post-restart boot_id read as 89779c16-0a4f-465c-9835-ffb227eaec6e, differing from baseline, proving reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node3 post-restart recovery and final cluster-wide firewall verification
evidence.summary: ssh service active on node3; final check from node3 to node1:9000 still rejected (exit 1) while node1:22 still reachable (exit 0), confirming firewall behavior survived all three node restarts
